articles.title: Simone Szabo, 79, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Simone Szabo for the many years of service to Eastgate.
body: Born in Eastgate in the years after the war, Simone Szabo spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Eastgate. Simone Szabo died in October at home on Eastgate Avenue, at the age of 79.

Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Canal Park Food Pantry in his or her name. Born in Eastgate in the years after the war, Simone Szabo spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
